```swift title="Swift"

import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"openai/text-embedding-3-small\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
```
